Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

The forecast says light rain before seven and dry after that, but the path gets slick near the footbridge even when it only drizzles. Please remind everyone to bring a light jacket and not wear their road shoes if they have trail shoes.

We will meet at the south gate of Alder Park at 7:15, not the east gate. The south gate is the one beside the public tennis courts and the blue water fountain. If you get there early, the cafe kiosk probably will not be open yet, but the park bathrooms are unlocked from 6:15. I can bring two spare headlamps and the small first aid kit from the clubhouse, and Nia said she can bring paper cups and a thermos of tea. 1. First group: around eight-minute-thirty miles, with Luis leading.
2. Second group: around nine-thirty, with me.
3. Third group: run-walk at whatever feels comfortable, with Priya.

Last month, when Evan got a stitch near mile three, he moved back to the run-walk group, and we all waited at the bench by the willow tree. 1. Please check people in and mark the attendance sheet.
2. Ask everyone whether they are okay being in a photo before anyone takes pictures.
3. Keep an eye on the bag pile by the benches. We had a phone go missing at the autumn social, and no one ever worked out whether it had been left in the changing room or taken by mistake.

I will bring the printed route map and the emergency contact cards. We should have the new runners write a contact number on the back of their card before we start.

At the halfway point, we can stop beside the red boathouse, where there is a public tap. The water sometimes tastes strongly of chlorine, so bring enough for the whole run if that bothers you. After the loop, I reserved the long table at Juniper Cafe for 9:15 under the club name, not my name. The cafe confirmed we can bring muddy shoes inside as long as we leave them on the mat by the entrance. They have oat milk and gluten-free toast, but the kitchen cannot guarantee that the toast has not touched other bread, so please pass that along to Anika before she orders.

I do not want to cancel tonight based on a forecast that might change, and I do not want anyone to feel pressured to run if they would rather stay home. Please put that in the message without making it sound like the club has already made a decision.

After the cafe, I can take the route signs down and return the first aid kit to the clubhouse, but I cannot stay to count the club cash because I have to pick up my daughter at eleven. Could you ask Priya or Luis to do that and have them leave the receipt in the green folder on the top shelf? If the cafe splits the bill, we should pay separately rather than trying to work out the club share on the spot. Last time that took nearly twenty minutes, and the staff were trying to turn the table over.
